title: Elf Bar Dual 10K Grape Edition Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Grape Edition Pre Filled Pods for the Elf Bar Dual 10K double down on bold grape flavour. One pod features Green Grape for a bright, crisp and slightly tart draw. The second pod adds deeper notes with sweet and juicy Black Grape. With integrated 5ml refill chambers, both pods offer long-lasting flavour without messy refills, thanks to the Dual 10K self-feeding system. Perfect for vapers who enjoy strong fruit flavour from start to finish. How to Use: 1. Remove the Sticker and Read the Instructions 2. Remove the Silicone Parts and the Bottom Sticker 3. Press both containers securely into place 4. Install the pod into the Dual 10K device to use
